title: 获奖来源外站房地产三维浏览、即时筛选与房源比较
scope: Awwwards-linked external inner page; specific award status requires official evidence
goal: 在原创房地产空间研究中比较完整房源，使用三维或静态路径选择、返回并生成本地简报。
workflow: 先等待实际场景并人工核对，加载进度或画布尺寸不证明正常三维已显示；视觉大写不一定是实际可访问名称。
区分三维镜头、时间光照示意、楼栋房源和筛选抽屉，记录状态作用区域；归一化时间步长不等于小时。
核实筛选是即时还是关闭后应用；完整目录数量、已确认过滤和未完成输入分开，未知面积或状态不变成零或可售。
图形中选择与键盘列表提供等价路径；详情、返回与浏览器历史恢复筛选、视角、焦点和位置，深链不擅自离开页面。
原创图形按需绘制，有轻量档与静态路径；图形加载失败、上下文丢失、数据摘要变化和卸载分别恢复或清理。
只生成明确本地的研究简报；工程模型、校准日照、实时库存、价格、预约与询价必须通过真实数据和授权接口另行验收。
failure_recovery: 无效范围保留并标记上次已确认结果；数据失败保留完整原创目录；图形失败不阻断筛选和阅读；模块加载失败允许重新载入，图形上下文可重试；旧简报随选择或状态变化失效。
motion_contract: 无自动旋转或背景动画，显式操作更新镜头和光照；减少动态也保持静止，触摸滚动不误选；释放当前实例的几何、材质、监听和渲染器，静态内容仍在。
source_relationship_note: An outbound work-detail association does not certify that every current inner page won an award or matches a historical version.
evidence_note: Only recorded observations are facts. DOM structure does not prove visual composition, hidden state, source code, backend behavior or licenses. The runnable blueprint is an original recipe, not a source-site clone.

property_contract.implementation: Original procedural two-building scene,12 fictional spaces, SVG plan and authored notes; licensed frozen Three0.187.0
property_contract.filter_timing: Instant valid choices; modal closing retains confirmed results. Invalid area drafts retain explicitly labeled previous confirmed results
property_contract.unknowns: Null area, room count, availability and price remain unknown; nonempty area bounds exclude unknown area; half-room units preserve fractional labels
property_contract.selection: Only confirmed matching units are selectable; pointer raycasting and keyboard catalogue reach same details; Return/Back restore origin; deep links recover locally
property_contract.graphics: Explicit enable, on-demand redraw, capped DPR and light quality. Module failure retains DOM and can reload; context loss can retry; old in-flight enhancement cannot resurrect after static/dispose
property_contract.brief: On-device original JSON only; revoked when selected space or view changes; not an inquiry, reservation, calibrated sunlight or engineering document
property_contract.editing: Regenerate complete static catalogue and notes after catalogue.json edits; exact data digest gates optional controls
